name: PayloadAdmissionFacts
kind: Original pure imported API-policy composition; not a Go HTTP framing port.

pins.parser_specialization: Decoded valid UTF-8 Text<=1024B; actual Go strconv.ParseInt(original,10,64) value and syntax/range class. Four result fields documented in ports/strconv/README.md.

input_domain.declared_length: Exact decoded validUTF8 Text,0..1024 bytes. It is not trimmed, normalized, sign-stripped, split or comma-joined. Missing header uses emptyText and occurrence0.
input_domain.integers: All three Integer values are exact signed64, including extrema. Negative metadata is semantically invalid but still returns a report preserving the inputs; no arithmetic is performed on invalid metadata.
input_domain.booleans: Exact Boolean values. Unknown/unverified access must be false; unknown/unverified request/body observation must be unbound. Unknown counts/byte counts/limit must not be invented as0; represent unavailability as a negative sentinel and/or unbound evidence.
input_domain.wire: Wrong/missing/null/type/oversize input route behavior requires its own future observation. No fabricated Report on upstream/compiler/import refusal. Native JSON may replace malformed rawUTF8/surrogates; no strict raw-wire preservation/refusal claim.

explicit_field_decision.change_from_research: Replace redundant parse_ok with parse_error_kind; rename http_decimal to unsigned_decimal. Seven original echoes plus seven derived facts stay14fields, below83916field limit.
explicit_field_decision.why: The range/syntax distinction and signed saturation remain visible even when an earlier access/context refusal wins. Parse success is derivable as kind0; neither a clamped numeric value nor Go ParseInt success grants admission.

derived_facts.echoes: All seven original input values are copied exactly. Signed64 extrema and Text bytes are not coerced or normalized.
derived_facts.parse_error_kind: Copy the imported parser error_kind:0 success,1 ErrSyntax,2 ErrRange. Compute parser facts for every in-domain Text even if metadata/access/context later refuses. The >1024 parser extension3 is outside this composition domain and is not claimed reachable.
derived_facts.parsed_value: Copy the imported parser returned int64 exactly, including syntax0 and signed range saturation. Never infer success from the value alone.
derived_facts.unsigned_decimal: True iff declared_length is nonempty and every decoded UTF8 byte is ASCII0x30..0x39. Leading zeros ARE accepted. Plus/minus signs, whitespace, comma,underscore,NUL,Unicode digits/sign lookalikes are false. This is a spelling fact, not HTTP framing validation.
derived_facts.length_matches: True iff imported parsed==true,error_kind==0,parsed_value>=0,observed_body_bytes>=0,and parsed_value==observed_body_bytes. Thus saturated MaxInt64 equal to observedMaxInt64 is NOT a match on a range error.
derived_facts.within_budget: True iff observed_body_bytes>=0,maximum_payload_bytes>=0,and observed_body_bytes<=maximum_payload_bytes. Descriptive independently of header validity/context/access. No sum/subtraction/multiplication can overflow.
derived_facts.eligible: True iff metadata valid,current_access,true binding,no Transfer-Encoding,exactly one Content-Length occurrence,parser facts internally consistent,parsed true/error_kind0,unsigned_decimal,length_matches,within_budget alltrue. No other fact or reasonfalse is permission.
derived_facts.reason: First matching entry in reason_precedence. Eligible iff reason0. Other booleans can be true in a refused report; never aggregate them as authorization.
derived_facts.defensive_parser_consistency: Require imported input==originalText and (parsed==true iff error_kind==0), with error_kind in0..2. Unknown/error_kind3 or inconsistent typed result yields reason12 after structural header guards. Compiler/import failure produces no invented result.

reason_precedence.name: INVALID_METADATA
reason_precedence.condition: Any occurrence/observed/max integer<0, or occurrences==0 with nonempty declared_length.

reason_precedence.name: CONTENT_LENGTH_REPEATED
reason_precedence.condition: content_length_occurrences>1; equal repeated fields are also refused.

reason_precedence.name: PARSER_FACT_UNSUPPORTED
reason_precedence.condition: Defensive unreachable branch for the pinned in-domain parser: unexpected error_kind, parsed/error inconsistency, or parser input echo mismatch. Never treat an unsupported/import failure as eligible.

reason_precedence.name: PARSE_RANGE
reason_precedence.condition: Imported parse_error_kind==2; signed saturation is retained but never accepted as a length.

reason_precedence.name: UNSIGNED_DECIMAL_REQUIRED
reason_precedence.condition: unsigned_decimal==false after successful ParseInt; e.g.+1 or-0.

reason_precedence.name: ELIGIBLE_WITHIN_DECLARED_FACTS
reason_precedence.condition: Every preceding refusal absent and all stated eligibility predicates true.

reason_order_notes: Invalid metadata dominates all context refusals; current access dominates unbound; unbound dominates TE; TE dominates missing/repeated headers.
Missing/repeated headers dominate parser classification; a missing empty value can still expose syntax facts while reason remains missing.

Syntax and range retain imported Go precedence BEFORE unsigned spelling. Therefore uint64 overflow encountered before an invalid suffix can report PARSE_RANGE while unsigned_decimal=false. Both refuse.
Go-success+1/-0 reaches unsigned spelling refusal. Nonempty ASCII digits can still be range-rejected.
Mismatch dominates budget failure when both occur. Zero observed length and zero limit are valid when the exact declared0 header is otherwise eligible.
Reason12 is defensive and unreachable for the fixed compliant in-domain parser; finite input fixtures do not claim to cover it.

truthful_host_binding.same_observation: The host must truthfully supply the raw selected Content-Length value, count of ALL original field occurrences, TE presence, complete observed body byte count, applicable route limit and current access for the same exact request/body/principal/operation and policy context. This function has no request ID or proof verifier and cannot establish that truth.
truthful_host_binding.occurrence_extraction: Count original field occurrences before filtering/coalescing. A single comma-containing field remains one occurrence with its complete raw value; do not split/trim/coalesce it into a permissible input. For repeated fields raw declared_length may be one exact selected original value, but count>1 always refuses.
truthful_host_binding.binding_boolean: True means all payload-associated raw header/body observations correspond to the same exact selected request/body snapshot and are complete/verified. Any unavailable/unverified/normalized-away framing fact requires false; TE unknown must not masquerade as absent. Current-access and route-limit truth must also be bound to that same operation context by the host.
truthful_host_binding.decision_use: The host must enforce current authority and bind/check the decision at use; it must handle revocation, body changes, TOCTOU, quotas/reservations, cancellation and actual network framing. No adapter,atomic claim,enforcement,clock,network I/O,body reader or send is implemented.
truthful_host_binding.human_approval: The pure function requires no per-request human approval and performs no effect. This does not prove that an external effect is safe without a correctly enforcing host.

HTTP_scope: Deliberately stricter single-Content-Length/no-TE policy. It refuses some otherwise valid HTTP requests (including missing length), and does not implement net/http,RFC framing,chunked decoding,duplicate-header reconciliation,request-smuggling prevention,stream completeness or a security guarantee. unsigned_decimal is only ASCII spelling.

deterministic_Gooo_design.imports: import decimal "go/strconv"; one call decimal.ParseIntDecimal64(input0) outside the local scan. Read its returned4field record with ordinary field selectors.
deterministic_Gooo_design.scan: One local counter0..<literal1024 with unit step. Only read input0[offset] when offset<int64(len(input0)); set unsigned_decimal false on any nonASCII digit. EmptyText starts false. No nested loops/call-inside-loop,unbounded iteration,List,Go fallback,model/effect or optional fields.
deterministic_Gooo_design.facts_and_reason: Local Boolean comparisons and ordered if/else decide one reason, then one required14field record preserves all7inputs. Parser numeric values are never reparsed by the consumer.
deterministic_Gooo_design.record_budget: Two required scalar-field records: imported parser4fields and consumer14fields; each remains within the pinned compiler16field limit. Public validation must bind fresh workspace/source/type/native/replay evidence.

status_boundary: Public contract and input-only fixtures describe finite pure policy behavior. They are not a transport or host enforcement adapter; current checkout acceptance requires fresh native execution and saved replay against independent Go values.

input_corpus.expected_owner: Independent pinned Go oracle uses actual strconv.ParseInt and separately implemented policy; fixtures contain no expected values.
input_corpus.scope: Finite systematic metadata/context/count/parse/spelling/mismatch/budget witnesses, not an exhaustive product. Reason12, malformed wire, oversized Text, all HTTP or host truth are not established.
